== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Rosegold is an ancient continent that has been largely forgotten by the current [[inhabitants]] of [[Cradle]]. According to local legends, the land contains a mythical buried city that holds all the secrets of the [[sacred arts]]. It is said that anyone who discovers this city and explores its streets will acquire immense power, experience no obstacles when advancing their abilities, and gain celestial wisdom necessary for ascension. In the past, the concept of seeking easy [[advancement]] or refining one's [[Path]] was colloquially referred to as "Seeking Arelia" on the continent. Rosegold is geographically situated near [[Iceflower]], and the two were once connected. Additionally, a museum located on the continent is protected by a [[Herald]] from [[House Shen]] and is rumored to house an [[Abidan artifact]].}}
